reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: Measured 1.60-mm source planes map to all eight reconstructed parts and carrier. Proposed supported sheet range 1.6–2.4 mm.
mapping.socket: Measured 4.50 × 1.70-mm source rectangular loops map to two mast/base sockets and one pan/post socket each. Tongues remain 4.50-mm-wide, actual-sheet-thick, actual-sheet-deep. Proposed sockets add .10–.30-mm total clearance to both axes: default 4.65 × 1.75 mm, not identical source fit.
mapping.carrier: Measured bed-flat carrier and runners inspire original five-shelf frame with 32 horizontal bed-contact runners. Proposed runner width .8–1.2 and thickness .4–.6 mm, replacing reference .21–.22-mm tops. Runners anchor external part rims, not tongues, bores or sockets.
mapping.redesign: Original Roberval-style eight-part double-parallelogram balance: socket base, fixed two-pivot mast, two identical three-pivot beams, two end posts and two perpendicular shoulder-seated pans. Half reach 40–60 mm, equal mast/post spacing 26–38 mm, M3 bores 3.2–3.6 mm. Six external M3 joints, washers/shims to .6-mm axial face gaps, locknuts and adhesive are required. No hardware-free or calibrated weighing claim.
mapping.personalization: Images and actual accepted STL solids are mirrored through Z and Boolean-subtracted from the upward print face of the lower mast apron. Backing >=1 mm, keep-in radius 6.5 mm, no approach to pivot or tongue interfaces. No convex hull substitution; unsupported concave/hollow meshes explicitly rejected.
mapping.limitations: Source has 27 edge-adjacent components and nonwatertight defects. Source is measured reference only, not claimed repaired or redistributed. Our fresh CSG reconstruction uses .001-mm tolerance; numerical topology, fits and kinematics are checked, not friction, strength, stability or weighing accuracy.

retrieval.method: curl with browser User-Agent; binary mesh independently parsed by trimesh, cross-sections inspected at Z=.1,.5,1.59 mm; live upstream README and CC BY 4.0 license read
